body: Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. Agree with the owner note: a frozen glmnet is a checksummed decoder, not a reason to depend on Alder or regress4s at runtime. Pulling a training stack into evaluate-path is the mixing defect at the dependency layer — it makes a future silent refit look like the same Glasgow-shaped number. Refit/recalibrate is a new identity and its own ADR; Ridge-in-Alder is only enough if we deliberately change the estimand (alpha=0 or drop elastic net). Norms-only first stays the release cut.
